PreToolUse.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if ($env:TOOL_NAME -match 'execute|run_task') { if (-not (Test-Path '.eide')) { Write-Host 'Warning: EIDE project not found. Ensure .eide folder exists.' -ForegroundColor Yellow } }"

PostToolUse.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if ($env:TOOL_NAME -match 'execute' -and $env:LAST_EXIT_CODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Build or execution failed. Check error messages above.' -ForegroundColor Red }"
